{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "pkg/plugins/log/ifaces.go",
      "line": 23,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "api",
      "title": "Adding FromContext to Logger interface is a breaking change",
      "body": "The Logger interface now requires a FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger method. Any type implementing this interface (outside the two modified implementations) will fail to compile until updated. This includes potential internal implementations not shown in the diff, as well as external packages that may rely on this interface. The PR should update all implementations in the repository or provide a compatibility path."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go",
      "line": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "traceID is no longer logged in plugin request logs",
      "body": "The previous version of logRequest included traceID in logParams when traceID was non-empty (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext). After moving contextual logging to a separate middleware, the traceID block was removed and is not re-added by ContextualLoggerMiddleware. This loses trace correlation in the 'Plugin Request Completed' log lines, which may be a regression for users relying on traceID to connect logs with traces."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/plugins/log/logger.go",
      "line": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "FromContext fallback may silently discard contextual attributes",
      "body": "The FromContext method performs a type assertion to *log.ConcreteLogger. If d.l.FromContext(ctx) returns a different type (e.g., a different logger implementation or a non-ConcreteLogger wrapper), the assertion fails and the fallback d.New() is returned. This fallback logger does not contain the contextual attributes set by ContextualLoggerMiddleware (or any other context enrichment). As a result, logs produced by LoggerMiddleware would miss pluginId, endpoint, and other fields. Even if current infra/log always returns ConcreteLogger, this is fragile and could break silently if logging internals change."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go",
      "line": 1,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "test_gap",
      "title": "No tests for the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware",
      "body": "The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware is untested. It should have unit tests verifying that instrumentContext adds the expected contextual attributes (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) for QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics, and that these attributes are not added for stream methods (SubscribeStream, PublishStream, RunStream). Additionally, test that LoggerMiddleware (when configured) receives the enriched context and logs correctly."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/plugins/log/fake.go",
      "line": 46,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "test_gap",
      "title": "TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh instance, losing accumulated state",
      "body": "TestLogger.FromContext always returns NewTestLogger(), which creates a new TestLogger with zeroed Logs. If a test uses the same TestLogger instance across multiple requests and expects logs to accumulate, this will break. It also means that any context-specific logger attributes cannot be inspected later. While it's a test fake, it may cause confusing test failures if not used carefully."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware_test.go",
      "line": 21,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "style",
      "title": "Test function name not updated after file rename",
      "body": "The test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware even though the file was renamed to metrics_middleware_test.go and the middleware is now MetricsMiddleware. This is inconsistent and may confuse readers searching for tests by middleware name. Rename to TestMetricsMiddleware for clarity."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger interface is a breaking change
findings.body: The Logger interface now requires a FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger method. Any type implementing this interface (outside the two modified implementations) will fail to compile until updated. This includes potential internal implementations not shown in the diff, as well as external packages that may rely on this interface. The PR should update all implementations in the repository or provide a compatibility path.

findings.title: traceID is no longer logged in plugin request logs
findings.body: The previous version of logRequest included traceID in logParams when traceID was non-empty (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext). After moving contextual logging to a separate middleware, the traceID block was removed and is not re-added by ContextualLoggerMiddleware. This loses trace correlation in the 'Plugin Request Completed' log lines, which may be a regression for users relying on traceID to connect logs with traces.

findings.title: FromContext fallback may silently discard contextual attributes
findings.body: The FromContext method performs a type assertion to *log.ConcreteLogger. If d.l.FromContext(ctx) returns a different type (e.g., a different logger implementation or a non-ConcreteLogger wrapper), the assertion fails and the fallback d.New() is returned. This fallback logger does not contain the contextual attributes set by ContextualLoggerMiddleware (or any other context enrichment). As a result, logs produced by LoggerMiddleware would miss pluginId, endpoint, and other fields. Even if current infra/log always returns ConcreteLogger, this is fragile and could break silently if logging internals change.

findings.title: No tests for the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware is untested. It should have unit tests verifying that instrumentContext adds the expected contextual attributes (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) for QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics, and that these attributes are not added for stream methods (SubscribeStream, PublishStream, RunStream). Additionally, test that LoggerMiddleware (when configured) receives the enriched context and logs correctly.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh instance, losing accumulated state
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext always returns NewTestLogger(), which creates a new TestLogger with zeroed Logs. If a test uses the same TestLogger instance across multiple requests and expects logs to accumulate, this will break. It also means that any context-specific logger attributes cannot be inspected later. While it's a test fake, it may cause confusing test failures if not used carefully.

findings.title: Test function name not updated after file rename
findings.body: The test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware even though the file was renamed to metrics_middleware_test.go and the middleware is now MetricsMiddleware. This is inconsistent and may confuse readers searching for tests by middleware name. Rename to TestMetricsMiddleware for clarity.
